goal: Align the real pipeline log, changed-files, configuration, error, and debug surfaces with shared responsive diagnostic patterns without changing routes, APIs, permissions, or inventing prototype-only data.
non_goals: Do not add or change routes, API methods/payloads, stores, backend fields, persistence, dependencies, authentication, or permission calculation.

Do not invent diff hunks/statistics, config validation or editing, remediation suggestions, previous-success comparisons, interactive debug sessions, artifacts, annotations, image/agent/resource data, or any prototype fixture.
Do not change the task 3.1 header/actions, task 3.2 overview, current stepId log routing, or approved prototype.
expected_evidence: Focused red/green tests for log filters/wrapping and preserved actions, changed-file/config/error empty states, debug permission/download behavior, and responsive containment.
Full frontend Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff output.
Desktop and 390px browser evidence for real log, changed-file, config, error, and debug states in dark Simplified Chinese plus representative light/English and push/read-only permissions.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent A2/A3/A4 spec and quality reviews.
unsafe_assumptions: Changed file paths do not imply diff hunks or line statistics.
Decoded historical configuration is read-only and cannot be assumed valid or safe to rewrite.
Current error objects may omit file, field, docs, suggestion, step, exit-code, previous-success, or log-context data.
The metadata download endpoint does not create an interactive debug session.
Client-side log presentation state must not alter retrieval, streaming, line anchors, download, deletion, grouping, or route semantics.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation requires any file outside the thirteen allowed files, a router/API/store/backend/dependency/permission contract, unsupported diagnostic data, editable config, interactive debug sessions, or a change to current step-log semantics.
